summary: Firefox’s CSS engine now fills in more of the modern CSS Typed OM transform features, including CSSMatrixComponent, CSSTransformComponent, CSSPerspective, and CSSSkew, and recognizes the new grid-lanes display value. It also adds HTML-standard default styling for option, optgroup, and legend, while improving font handling, UTF-8 processing, stylesheet loading checks, and selector and property-set performance; navigation rate limiting adds a separate safety improvement.
